title: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers…
description: Umami versions 3.3.0 up to but not including 3.5.0 contain a race condition in the two-factor authentication (2FA) attempt limiting mechanism. This flaw allows an attacker who already knows a user's password to bypass the lockout that normally limits failed 2FA attempts. By sending many concurrent POST requests to the /api/2fa/verify endpoint, the attacker can circumvent the five-attempt limit and brute-force TOTP or backup codes.
